run:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads undirected weighted graph test cases from standard input until a zero sentinel, applies a two-pass minimum-edge selection over the adjacency matrix, accumulates a count from the selected edge costs, and prints the count for each graph." run]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Create a Scanner named scan that reads from System.in. RESULT scan]
            [COMMAND Start a while loop that continues as long as scan.hasNext() is true. RESULT while_loop]
            [COMMAND Within the while loop, read the next integer and store it as n. RESULT n]
            [COMMAND Within the while loop, if n equals 0, break out of the while loop immediately. RESULT loop_exit]
            [COMMAND Within the while loop, read the next integer and store it as m. RESULT m]
            [COMMAND Within the while loop, allocate an n by n integer matrix cost and fill every cell with Integer.MAX_VALUE. RESULT cost]
            [COMMAND Within the while loop, for i from 0 to m-1 inclusive, read the next token, split it on commas, parse the three resulting parts as a, b, and c, then set cost[a][b] to c and cost[b][a] to c. RESULT cost]
            [COMMAND Within the while loop, initialize count to 0, min to 0, ti to 0, tj to 0, and a boolean array fl of length n with all false values. RESULT count_fl]
            [COMMAND Within the while loop, first pass: for i from 0 to n-2 inclusive, reset min to 0; for j from i+1 to n-1 inclusive, skip to the next j if cost[i][j] equals Integer.MAX_VALUE, otherwise using short-circuit evaluation, if min is 0 or min is greater than cost[i][j], set min to cost[i][j], ti to i, and tj to j. After the inner j loop, if min is not 0, add (integer division of min by 100, minus 1) to count and set fl[ti] and fl[tj] to true. RESULT count_fl]
            [COMMAND Within the while loop, second pass: for i from 0 to n-1 inclusive, skip to the next i if fl[i] is true; otherwise reset min to 0; for j from 0 to i-1 inclusive, skip to the next j if cost[j][i] equals Integer.MAX_VALUE, otherwise using short-circuit evaluation, if min is 0 or min is greater than cost[j][i], set min to cost[j][i]. After the inner j loop, if min is not 0, add (integer division of min by 100, minus 1) to count. RESULT count]
            [COMMAND Within the while loop, print the value of count. RESULT console_output]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
